paragraphs: Abba the priest Bardela. Resh Lakish said in Abba’s name, etc. (Bava Metzia 10a–b: two things; Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Hazorek Get, halakhah 3, and chapter Yesh Nochalin: Resh Lakish in his name.) In Sifrei on Elleh Haddevarim: Abba Yose ben Chanina (29d: ben Chanan; in Midrash Chazit on “My dove in the clefts of the rock”: Rabbi Avun) in his name. Jerusalem Talmud, Pe'ah, chapter 4: bar Delaya; beginning of Bava Metzia: bar Delayah. Chapter Haddar: “people of Bardelyah,” explained as a place name. Rabbah, Vayigash, end of section 93: Mattenot Kehunah explains “son of a man called Dela” (see there). See below, Rav Acha Bardela. It appears that he was among the later tannaim of the baraitot.
